## How to read in data

```{python}
import pandas as pd

DATA = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LucyMcGowan/sta-363-f26/main/data/"
Default = pd.read_csv(DATA + "Default.csv")
Default.head()
```

The above example reads in the `Default` dataset. To read a different dataset, just swap the "*.csv" part, for example to instead read in the `Auto` data we'd change the above code from `Default.csv` to `Auto.csv`.

## The data sets

| Data set | Rows | Columns | Missing | ISLP chapters | Description |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| [`Auto.csv`](data/Auto.csv) | 392 | 9 | | 2, 3, 5 | Gas mileage, horsepower, and other characteristics of 392 cars. |
| [`Boston.csv`](data/Boston.csv) | 506 | 13 | | 3, 8 | Housing values and neighborhood characteristics for 506 Boston census tracts. |
| [`Caravan.csv`](data/Caravan.csv) | 5,822 | 86 | | 4 | Demographic characteristics of 5,822 customers and whether they bought caravan insurance. |
| [`Carseats.csv`](data/Carseats.csv) | 400 | 11 | | 8 | Simulated child car seat sales at 400 stores. |
| [`Credit.csv`](data/Credit.csv) | 400 | 12 | | 6 | Credit card balance and customer characteristics for 400 people. |
| [`Default.csv`](data/Default.csv) | 10,000 | 4 | | 2, 4 | Credit card default, balance, income, and student status for 10,000 customers. |
| [`Hitters.csv`](data/Hitters.csv) | 322 | 20 | 59 | 6, 8 | Salary and 1986 performance for 322 Major League Baseball players. |
| [`NCI60.csv`](data/NCI60.csv) | 64 | 6,831 | | 1 | Gene expression, 6,830 genes measured on 64 cancer cell lines. |
| [`Smarket.csv`](data/Smarket.csv) | 1,250 | 9 | | 1, 4 | Daily S&P 500 percentage returns from 2001 to 2005. |
| [`Wage.csv`](data/Wage.csv) | 3,000 | 11 | | 1, 7 | Wage and demographic data for 3,000 male workers in the Atlantic region. |
